import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 1000005;
    static final long mod = 998244353;
    static final long modd = 1000000007;
    static long[] st = new long[15];
    static ArrayList<String>[] lenn = new ArrayList[7];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] ok = new ArrayList[7][7];
    static long[][] sum = new long[7][7];
    static long number = 1;
    static String s;
    
    static long goal(String str) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < str.length(); ++i) {
            res = res * 10 + (str.charAt(i) - '0');
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Integer> list, int key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }
    
    static long get(String cur, int max_len) {
        if (max_len == -1) return 0;
        int L = max_len / 2;
        int R = max_len - L;
        if (max_len == 1) {
            L = 1;
            R = 0;
        }
        long curGoal = goal(cur);
        long first = (number - curGoal) % mod;
        if (first < 0) first += mod;
        long ans = first % modd;
        number++;
        
        ArrayList<String> listL = lenn[L];
        for (String lef : listL) {
            long val = (number - goal(cur + lef)) % mod;
            if (val < 0) val += mod;
            ans = (ans + val) % modd;
            number++;
            if (lef.length() == L) {
                long c = goal(cur + lef) % mod;
                for (int oth = 1; oth <= R; ++oth) {
                    long prod = ((-c % mod + mod) % mod) * (st[oth] % mod) % mod;
                    long cnst = (prod + (number % mod)) % mod;
                    int key = (int)((mod - cnst) % mod);
                    ArrayList<Integer> listOK = ok[R][oth];
                    int to = lowerBound(listOK, key);
                    long size = listOK.size();
                    long termMod = ((size % modd) * (cnst % modd) % modd +
                                    (sum[R][oth] % modd) -
                                    (mod % modd) * ((size - to) % modd) % modd) % modd;
                    if (termMod < 0) termMod += modd;
                    ans = (ans + termMod) % modd;
                }
                number += lenn[R].size();
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static class Pair {
        String cur;
        int len;
        Pair(String cur, int len) {
            this.cur = cur;
            this.len = len;
        }
    }
    
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = in.nextLong();
        s = Long.toString(n);
        int N = s.length();  // not used, but kept for similarity
        
        st[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) st[i] = st[i - 1] * 10;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) lenn[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; ++j)
                ok[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; ++i) {
            String now = Integer.toString(i);
            while (now.length() <= 6) {
                lenn[now.length()].add(now);
                now = "0" + now;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            lenn[i].addAll(lenn[i - 1]);
            Collections.sort(lenn[i], null);
            for (int j = 0; j < lenn[i].size(); ++j) {
                String curStr = lenn[i].get(j);
                int len = curStr.length();
                int val = (j - Integer.parseInt(curStr) + (int)mod) % (int)mod;
                ok[i][len].add(val);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                Collections.sort(ok[i][j], null);
                long sval = 0;
                for (int v : ok[i][j]) sval += v;
                sum[i][j] = sval;
            }
        }
        
        ArrayList<Pair> Q = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder curBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            int digit = s.charAt(i) - '0';
            for (int j = 0; j <= 9; ++j) {
                if (j == digit) continue;
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                curBuilder.append((char)('0' + j));
                int len;
                if (j <= digit) {
                    len = s.length() - i - 1;
                } else {
                    len = s.length() - i - 2;
                }
                Q.add(new Pair(curBuilder.toString(), len));
                curBuilder.deleteCharAt(curBuilder.length() - 1);
            }
            curBuilder.append((char)('0' + digit));
            Q.add(new Pair(curBuilder.toString(), 0));
        }
        
        Collections.sort(Q, (p1, p2) -> p1.cur.compareTo(p2.cur));
        
        number = 1;
        long ans = 0;
        for (Pair p : Q) {
            if (p.cur.length() > 0 && s.charAt(p.cur.length() - 1) == p.cur.charAt(p.cur.length() - 1)) {
                long val = (number - goal(p.cur)) % mod;
                if (val < 0) val += mod;
                ans = (ans + val) % modd;
                number++;
            } else {
                long val = get(p.cur, p.len);
                ans = (ans + val) % modd;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
        in.close();
    }
}
